manual_review_reason: Fresh On The Net expressly accepts one track per artist per week through its first-party form using a public, worldwide and embeddable SoundCloud URL. The inbox is schedule- and capacity-gated, opening Monday morning and closing after 200 tracks or by Wednesday evening; it was closed on 2026-07-16 with a July 20 reopening boundary. A human must reopen the live form during an official window, inspect CAPTCHA/honeypot/consent controls without bypassing them, apply the strictest current AI-provenance rule because first-party pages conflict, verify the selected MarcsMusic track is eligible and has not been submitted before, confirm it is not a prohibited remix or alternate version, check SoundCloud availability and metadata, accept the terms and submit only one track. Do not email music, use the privacy mailbox, use individual volunteers, bypass the capacity gate or use the conditional Exile FM route before satisfying the Fresh On The Net prerequisite.
